headline: Nine o'clock keeps its coat on.
body: A cyclist waits at the crossing with one foot down, watching the bakery shutter rise only halfway. Flour is already on the step, and the offices above switch their strips on one room at a time. We let the hour in without calling it morning yet.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: pale gold behind the chimney pots

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: one foot down at the lights
